Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking time on Friday's tabletop. As part of our SOC 2 / SIG review we need the following artifacts from Redwood's April 11 rehearsal to close a couple of evidence gaps:

- CSV export of the rehearsal run log (timestamps, steps executed, outcomes)
- KV cache snapshot that shows warm-start hit rates during the scenario
- A dependency map (diagram) listing external services and owners that were exercised in the run
- RTO/RPO test summary (observed durations, any deviations)

If you can share those items and a short note confirming the window of simulated impact (start/end) plus the test account IDs we exercised, that would be ideal. We need to upload them to our SIG portal by Apr 22.

Thanks,
